arxiv-1702-05172.title: Long geodesics on convex surfaces
arxiv-1702-05172.creator: Arseniy Akopyan, Anton Petrunin
arxiv-1702-05172.description: Abstract We review the theory of intrinsic geometry of convex surfaces in the Euclidean space and prove the following theorem: if the boundary surface of a convex body K K contains arbitrarily long closed simple geodesics, then K K is an isosceles tetrahedron.

arxiv-2205-10674.title: NS 3 : Neuro-Symbolic Semantic Code Search Thanks: Equal supervision
arxiv-2205-10674.creator: Shushan Arakelyan, Anna Hakhverdyan, Miltiadis Allamanis
arxiv-2205-10674.description: Abstract Semantic code search is the task of retrieving a code snippet given a textual description of its functionality. Recent work has been focused on using similarity metrics between neural embeddings of text and code. However, current language models are known to struggle with longer, compositional text, and multi-step reasoning.

arxiv-2208-12888.title: Investigating data partitioning strategies for crosslinguistic low-resource ASR evaluation
arxiv-2208-12888.creator: Zoey Liu, Justin Spence, Emily Prud’hommeaux
arxiv-2208-12888.description: Abstract Many automatic speech recognition (ASR) data sets include a single pre-defined test set consisting of one or more speakers whose speech never appears in the training set. This “hold-speaker(s)-out" data partitioning strategy, however, may not be ideal for data sets in which the number of speakers is very small.

arxiv-2308-13907.title: On the non-commutative Neveu decomposition and stochastic ergodic theorems
arxiv-2308-13907.creator: Panchugopal Bikram, Diptesh Saha
arxiv-2308-13907.description: Abstract . In this article, we prove Neveu decomposition for the action of locally compact amenable semigroup of positive contractions on semifinite von Neumann algebras and thus, it entirely resolves the problem for the actions of arbitrary amenable semigroup on semifinite von Neumann algebras.

arxiv-2507-03231.title: Robust and Efficient Embedded Convex Optimization through First-Order Adaptive Caching
arxiv-2507-03231.creator: Ishaan Mahajan, Brian Plancher
arxiv-2507-03231.description: Abstract Recent advances in Model Predictive Control (MPC) leveraging a combination of first-order methods, such as the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM), and offline precomputation and caching of select operations, have excitingly enabled real-time MPC on microcontrollers. Unfortunately, these approaches require the use of fixed hyperparameters, limiting their adaptability and overall performance.

pmc-12382219.title: Investigating the orthotic effect of a passive gravity-compensated exoskeletal device on upper-limb function in people with multiple sclerosis: a pilot cross-sectional study
pmc-12382219.creator: Thomas Bowman, Alessandro Torchio, Ilaria Carpinella, Tito Dinon, Erica Grange, Rachele Di Giovanni, Claudio Marcello Solaro, Davide Cattaneo, Marco Caimmi
pmc-12382219.description: BackgroundMultiple Sclerosis (MS) is a neurodegenerative disorder causing lower and upper-limb (UL) impairments and significantly affecting independence. Current assistive technologies for UL rehabilitation in People with MS (PwMS) rely on actuated robotic systems, which present high costs and complexity. Passive gravity-compensated exoskeletons represent a promising alternative; however, their functional benefits remain underexplored.

pmc-12388785.title: Optimizing Endoscopic Transpyloric Feeding Tube Placement in Low Birth Weight Infants: Practical Insights from Clinical Experience
pmc-12388785.creator: Yeoun Joo Lee, Hansol Kim, Shin Yun Byun, Narae Lee, Mun Hui Jung, Seung Hee Jeong, Ballambhattu Vishnu Bhat
pmc-12388785.description: Background and Objectives: Transpyloric (TP) feeding tube placement is a viable nutritional strategy in low birth weight infants (LBWIs) with severe gastroesophageal reflux or feeding intolerance. However, technical challenges are encountered in patients of this age group due to their small body size and the limited availability of appropriately sized equipment.

pmc-12400821.title: Modified electroconvulsive therapy for perinatal depression: scoping review
pmc-12400821.creator: William V. Bobo, Owen Moore, Catherine B. Hurley, Robyn Rosasco, Emily E. Sharpe, Alyssa M. Larish, Katherine M. Moore, Hannah K. Betcher
pmc-12400821.description: BackgroundModified electroconvulsive therapy (mECT), the administration of ECT under general anesthesia with muscular relaxation, is indicated for perinatal depression complicated by high severity, psychosis, catatonia, or resistance to conventional therapeutics; however, knowledge gaps remain regarding its effectiveness and safety in depressed patients and its fetal/neonatal risk profile.

pmc-12433926.title: TWISTER (Twente water injection system for turbulence experimental research): a jet array in the Twente water tunnel for generating strong turbulence using four-dimensional gradient noise
pmc-12433926.creator: Duco van Buuren, Dennis P M van Gils, Gert-Wim Bruggert, Dominik Krug
pmc-12433926.description: We present a newly constructed jet array with a novel driving scheme for turbulence generation in a vertical water tunnel and measurements of the turbulent flow this jet array establishes. The design of the array allows us to control the mean background flow and the turbulence intensity independently of each other.

pmc-12965816.title: A Proposed North American Approach for Genetic Testing of Individuals at Risk for Malignant Hyperthermia
pmc-12965816.creator: Sheila Riazi, Stacey Watt, Jennifer Plester, Leslie G. Biesecker
pmc-12965816.description: Malignant hyperthermia, a pharmacogenetic disorder of skeletal muscle, is a potentially fatal reaction triggered by exposure to volatile anesthetics or succinylcholine. Genetic testing of the three known involved genes (RYR1, CACNA1S, and STAC3) has become the first line of testing for malignant hyperthermia susceptibility. However, genetic testing has sensitivity of only up to 70%.

pmc-13040868.title: Generation and characterization of a novel Gaa compound heterozygous mouse model recapitulating human Pompe disease
pmc-13040868.creator: Wenjun Huang, Jie Wang, Yafei Zhou, Hongyu Xiao, Kaichong Jiang, Jiale Cui, Yanmin Zhang, Rui Zhou
pmc-13040868.description: BackgroundPompe disease (PD), caused by a deficiency in acid α-glucosidase (GAA), is a lysosomal storage disorder. Existing Gaa knockout and point mutation mouse models have substantially advanced mechanistic understanding, but most are homozygous for single mutations and do not faithfully model the compound‑heterozygous GAA genotypes common in patients.

pmc-13281357.title: Celiac trunk thrombosis and splenic infarction in a patient with ankylosing spondylitis under adalimumab: a case report
pmc-13281357.creator: Eva Grundmann, Janet Maksin, David Ertman, Bertram Feil
pmc-13281357.description: BackgroundCeliac trunk thrombosis is a rare vascular emergency that can lead to life-threatening complications including bowel ischemia and multi-organ dysfunction. The association between inflammatory autoimmune arthropathies and thrombotic events is well-established, but celiac trunk involvement remains exceptionally uncommon. This case highlights the diagnostic challenges and management considerations in patients with underlying inflammatory autoimmune conditions.

pmc-13372860.title: Proportion and clinical characteristics of keratoconus among patients attending refraction units: a retrospective facility-based study in Malawi
pmc-13372860.creator: Leaveson Thom, Vanessa V. R. Moodley
pmc-13372860.description: PurposeThis study assessed the facility-based proportion, demographic profile, clinical characteristics, and factors associated with KC among patients attending tertiary referral refraction clinics in Malawi.MethodsA retrospective cross-sectional review of clinical records was conducted at Malawi’s four national referral eye hospitals. Records of patients aged 10–45 years who attended refraction services between January 2014 and December 2018 were reviewed.

pmc-13486484.title: Gas capture and selective sensing performance of graphene-like AlNC2 monolayer: a DFT study
pmc-13486484.creator: Masoumeh Molaei
pmc-13486484.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The gas adsorption behavior of a recently proposed graphene-like AlNC₂ monolayer was systematically investigated using density functional theory calculations. The structural stability of the AlNC₂ sheet was confirmed using cohesive energy calculations and phonon dispersion spectrum analysis. The interaction of several environmentally harmful gases including CO, NO, NO₂, SO₂, NH₃, H₂S, and CH₄ with the AlNC₂ surface was examined by calculating adsorption energies, charge density difference, work-function changes, density of states, and recovery times.

pmc-13537744.title: Prevalencia de automedicación en mujeres embarazadas atendidas en un hospital público de Cartagena, Colombia, 2023-2024
pmc-13537744.creator: Ana María Bello Trujillo, Nestor Lora Villamil, Melissa Iriarte Camargo, Gabriela Jinete Cervantes, Carlos Avellaneda Martinez, Diego Cabarcas Castilla, Rogelio Méndez Rodríguez
pmc-13537744.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). RESUMENObjetivo: Describir la práctica de automedicación en el embarazo en gestantes atendidas en la Clínica Maternidad Rafael Calvo entre junio de 2023 y febrero de 2024.Metodología: Estudio de corte transversal. Se incluyeron mujeres gestantes mayores de 14 años, recibidas en atención ambulatoria u hospitalización, entre junio de 2023 y febrero de 2024, en una institución de atención materno-infantil de referencia, ubicada Cartagena (Colombia).
